newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off as foreign interest wanes.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off as foreign interest wanes.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off in light trade, cooling Tuesday's surge, as recent foreign interest in blue chips waned, traders said.
"Yesterday's impulse seems to have gone," said Multinvest broker Mario Simosa. "Today's players were mostly local investors, and they didn't ignite the market."

The 19-share index slipped a hair, closing off 0.01 percent at 6.679.50 points as 22 million shares traded worth 2.8 billion bolivars ($5.9 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange. Among traded issues, 19 fell, nine rose and 12 closed flat.
Market leader CANTV closed down 19.25 bolivars at 2081.25, while utility Electricidad de Caracas slipped 5.00 bolivars to end at 532.50 after surging ahead 12.00 boivars Tuesday.
CANTV nine-month earnings per share fell to 104.1 bolivars versus 154.1 over the same period the year before. The results were released earlier today.
